title: The message time check reads the bracket stamp form
why: Incident 13:13-13:14 CST Nov 12: the retrospective's four messages stamped 13:16 and 13:19 CST were sent at 13:13-13:14 CST; it wrote the times without reading the clock (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard).
note: Guard message-time-matches-clock let them through: its header pattern (hooks/guard_merge.py _STAMP_HEADER) needs a comma, colon or dash after the sender words, and the bracket form "[consultant 13:19 CST]" has none. The coordinator uses the same form, so every bracket stamp goes unchecked. Fix: the pattern accepts a leading "[<words> HH:MM CST]". Red first on "[consultant 13:19 CST] x" at 13:14. Same family as step stamp-guard-send-message (lane session_013NEJL2w2TGYjZFexEa6uyw): fold in if that lane takes it. Folded 13:18 CST Nov 12 into lane stamp-guard-send-message (coordinator). Incident 15:35 CST Nov 12 (retrospective): triage stamped messages "Triage 15:45 CST" and "Triage 15:46 CST" at clock 15:35 to 15:36, and wrote unread times (15:31, 15:33, 15:35, 15:42 CST) into page item replies, refs and option notes. Message-time-matches-clock passed them all: a header without the bracket form is not read, and page item text is not checked. Fixed on the page by 15:39 CST (times dropped). Gap: check every "HH:MM CST" stamp a session writes for itself in send_message bodies and page item fields, with or without brackets. Rule building-mistake-names-its-guard. Incident 16:14 CST Nov 12: triage again wrote a stamp from memory (16:16 CST at clock 16:14) in two messages, an outbox line and the handoff; the send hook caught the messages, the outbox line and handoff were fixed by hand. Gap: nothing checks stamps in roadmap/outbox lines or handoff text. Sighting, coordinator 16:53 CST Nov 12: its sends at 16:51-16:52 CST carried leading stamps "Coordinator 16:53 CST" and "Coordinator 16:54 CST", ahead of now-central, and the send-time hook message-time-matches-clock let them through (it refused triage's ahead stamp at 16:14 CST). Gap: a leading "<Role> HH:MM CST" stamp that runs ahead of the clock is not refused.
